NEW ZEALAND'S THERMAL REGIONS.

A magnificent camera study secured at Orekoikorako, about 40 miles south of Rotorus, North Island. This district on account of the difficulties of access, is not very well known even to New Zealanders. It is the seat of great thermal activity. The photograph shows boiling pools in the background, while the man is standing on a crust formed by the silica deposits from the thermal springs.
